ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark/black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity dark region concentrated around the peduncle and median notch, radiating outwards into the mid-sections of both lobes. Dense mottling and isolated dark pixel clusters are visible in the lower-left and lower-right quadrants against a high-intensity white background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 85 degrees and a significant depth relative to the posterior lobe margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; notably deeper and more pronounced indentations are present on the inner trailing edges adjacent to the median notch, with finer peaks towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve along the leading edges meeting at sharp, upward-sweeping distal points; lobes exhibit a roughly symmetrical outward and upward trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast textured pixels (barnacle colonies) are concentrated on the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, near-vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions are visible on the high-intensity white field of the right lobe; shorter, horizontal scratches are detectable on the left lobe mid-section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on distal tips; highly irregular trailing edge topography suggests cumulative minor physical wear or environmental interaction.
other_distinctive_markers: The pigmentation forms a distinct 'bat-wing' or 'butterfly' dark pattern centered on the notch, surrounded by an expansive high-intensity white field.
